changelog:
Initial release of the HomeBox Skill.

- Enables interaction with HomeBox home inventory via REST API for searching, adding, updating, deleting, and listing items, locations, and tags.
- Includes a cross-platform Node.js CLI for all inventory management operations.
- Supports both API v1 (hay-kot) and v2 (sysadminsmedia), with automatic version detection or manual override.
- Provides guidance for handling self-signed TLS certificates and required environment setup.
- Emphasizes natural language input, conversational interaction, and efficient confirmations for write operations.
- Details best practices for setup, token handling, ID management, and API operation differences.
